topic: Using Remotion to make a business reel

sources.title: Composition component
sources.claim: A composition registers a renderable video component with dimensions, frame rate, duration, an ID, and optional JSON serializable default props.

sources.title: Render your video
sources.claim: The Remotion CLI and server side rendering API can render a selected composition to a video file.

sources.title: Video documentation
sources.claim: Remotion provides components and timing primitives for constructing video sequences.

scopeNote: Examples are illustrative. The repository's pinned Remotion version and production configuration govern the actual command and export requirements.
